en.title: Leafy Market
en.keywords: seeds seed farming supplies grocery crops shop green leaf logo city center weaponry vegetables fertilizer strawberry lettuce
en.entryHtml:
Shopping

Leafy Market

Officially described as a grocery chain carrying fresh produce, seeds and farming supplies, with multiple branches around the city center.

Interior confirmed in the current build Video-observed (Games Station, 03:15–03:55): the shop UI is split into four tabs — Seed & Fertilizer / Vegetables / Grocery / Weaponry (Temporary) — and the in-store scene shows the green leaf logo with a cashier NPC at the counter, matching the recognition advice below. Observed retail shelf prices: Green Salad 70C in Vegetables (03:25) and Revolver 1,776C in Weaponry (Temporary) (03:22) — both are purchase prices, not player sell prices; see the money-making guide for the full anchor list.

How to recognize it: look for the green leaf storefront logo. Because the official material shows a chain rather than one unique shop, choose the nearest visible branch and submit a phone-map screenshot if its current pin is readable.

Go here forSeeds, fertilizer, produce, groceriesOfficial sourceInterior video-observedExact branch pins need a current screenshot

en.title: Auction Market
en.keywords: auction market players trade phone app companion
en.entryHtml:
Shopping

Auction market

The official site describes the auction market as a player-to-player trading market that is directly accessible from within the game and from the companion phone app — you open it from the in-game menu or the app rather than walking to a dedicated building.

We found no verified physical auction-house building location in the current Early Access build, so the map deliberately shows no pin here; the earlier fan-wiki-suggested position has been removed to avoid misleading directions. If you capture a current-build screenshot of a physical auction building, submit it with the map label and we will add a verified pin.
